messages:
Sam: Quick contract question about chat/completions streaming + tool/function calling. If clients get interleaved chunks for assistant message deltas and toolcall chunks, what's the canonical reconstruction order? e.g., assistant pre-tool -> tool chunks -> assistant post-tool? Need to update SDK docs if so.
Laura: Yes — that's the model. The runtime emits chunks in logical order. We rely on a chunk.type to let clients reassemble: message.delta, tool.call.start, tool.call.delta, tool.call.end, done.
Micah: Can we avoid renaming existing chunk keys? Mobile SDKs are fragile.
Laura: Agreed. Instead of renaming, add chunk.kind (string) and keep existing fields. New clients can read kind; old clients ignore unknown fields. Backcompat pattern.
Anya: Example payload sketch so reviewers know what to expect:
```
{type: message.delta, role: assistant, delta: 'I can search that for you...'}
{type: tool.call.start, name: 'web_search', meta: {query_id: 42}}
{type: tool.call.delta, output: 'result snippet 1'}
{type: tool.call.delta, output: 'result snippet 2'}
{type: tool.call.end, status: 'ok'}
{type: message.delta, role: assistant, delta: 'Found these results and summarized.'}
{type: done, finish_reason: function_call}
```
Note: Using single-quoted strings in this sketch to avoid ambiguity; real JSON will use double quotes.
Sam: Also need explicit guidance for finish_reason values — 'function_call' vs 'stop' vs 'length' and how clients map them to onComplete behaviors.
Laura: We'll document finish_reason enum and add a compatibility note: treat unknown finish_reason as generic completion.
Micah: Another edge: what if client disconnects mid-toolcall? Do we guarantee a tool.call.end with error meta?
Anya: Runtime should emit a final tool.call.end with error:{code:'client_disconnect'} so SDKs can render partial tool output. I'll add tests.
Micah: Can we add a streaming harness test that simulates a dropped TCP and asserts we still emit end+error? That would catch regressions.
Anya: I'll open a PR with tests and a small shim for the streaming parser that tolerates missing end markers.
Deploy-bot: New PR 4392 opened by anya: stream-toolcall-backcompat-tests -> eng-platform.
Micah: Ack, will review this afternoon.
Sam: Thanks. I'll draft a short compatibility note for SDKs (JS, iOS, Android) outlining: keep reading unknown chunk.kind, treat finish_reason unknown as stop, and reassemble tool chunks by canonical sequence. Will link into PR and docs.
Laura: One more: request param name stays messages (array of role/message objects), not 'input'. Also function_call in request accepts 'auto'|'none'|{"name":"X"} — we'll call that out in the spec.
Sam: Perfect. If anyone has objections to chunk.kind approach, say now, otherwise I'll add the note and mark this thread resolved. :thumbsup:
